random_streams.count_keys: Only unique current/following keys required by positive-weight rows

poisson_reference.note: Approximate plug-in elasticity reference; RA/xbar is approximated by one and half-count ratios stabilize inverses. Not exact nonlinear normalized Poisson variance. Recomputed per draw.

known_count_model.interpretation: conditional mechanism check only; not interval-coverage validation

monte_carlo.rule: Uniform doubling of all bootstrap inner counts, up to cap, based on MC SE / estimated sampling SE; no significance rule. B<10 only diagnoses.

failure_policy: Any failed inner fit makes that q average undefined; no silent averaging over successful fits.
